mapper.select: SELECT P.POST_ID, P.MEMBER_ID, P.POST_CONTENT, P.CREATED_AT, IFNULL(M.LOGIN_ID, CONCAT(LEFT(M.MEMBER_NAME, 1), REPEAT('*', CHAR_LENGTH(M.MEMBER_NAME) - 1))) AS DISPLAY_NAME, M.SOCIAL_TYPE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_LIKE L WHERE L.POST_ID = P.POST_ID) AS LIKE_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT C WHERE C.POST_ID = P.POST_ID AND C.COMMENT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE') AS COMMENT_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_LIKE L2 WHERE L2.POST_ID = P.POST_ID AND L2.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}) AS LIKED FROM COMMUNITY_POST P JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = P.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.POST_ID DESC LIMIT #{startNum}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_POST P JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = P.MEMBER_ID
SELECT COMMUNITY_POST_ID AS postId, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, IMAGE_ORIGIN_NAME AS imageOriginName FROM COMMUNITY_IMAGE WHERE COMMUNITY_POST_ID IN #{id} ORDER BY COMMUNITY_POST_ID, DISPLAY_ORDER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMUNITY_POST ( MEMBER_ID, POST_TITLE, POST_CONTENT, POST_STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{postTitle}, #{postContent}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO COMMUNITY_IMAGE ( COMMUNITY_POST_ID, IMAGE_URL, IMAGE_ORIGIN_NAME, IMAGE_NAME, IMAGE_SIZE, IMAGE_TYPE, DISPLAY_ORDER ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageOriginName}, #{imageName}, #{imageSize}, #{imageType}, #{displayOrder} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND ROLE = 'ADMIN' AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO COMMUNITY_LIKE (POST_ID, MEMBER_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{postId}, #{memberId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM COMMUNITY_LIKE WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_LIKE WHERE POST_ID = #{postId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_LIKE WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.sql: WHERE P.POST_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COMMUNITY_HASHTAG H WHERE H.POST_ID = P.POST_ID AND H.TAG_NAME = #{tag})
mapper.select: SELECT C.COMMENT_ID AS commentId, C.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, C.PARENT_COMMENT_ID AS parentCommentId, IF(C.COMMENT_STATUS = 'DELETED', '', C.COMMENT_CONTENT) AS commentContent, C.COMMENT_STATUS AS commentStatus, DATE_FORMAT(C.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, IFNULL(M.LOGIN_ID, CONCAT(LEFT(M.MEMBER_NAME, 1), REPEAT('*', CHAR_LENGTH(M.MEMBER_NAME) - 1))) AS displayName, M.SOCIAL_TYPE AS socialType FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT C JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = C.MEMBER_ID WHERE C.POST_ID = #{postId} AND (C.COMMENT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' OR (C.COMMENT_STATUS = 'DELETED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT R WHERE R.PARENT_COMMENT_ID = C.COMMENT_ID AND R.COMMENT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'))) ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT, C.COMMENT_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMUNITY_COMMENT ( POST_ID, MEMBER_ID, PARENT_COMMENT_ID, COMMENT_CONTENT, COMMENT_STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{memberId}, #{parentCommentId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{commentContent}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE COMMUNITY_COMMENT SET COMMENT_STATUS = 'DELETED' WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId} AND COMMENT_STATUS != 'DELETED' AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND COMMENT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_POST WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND POST_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{parentCommentId} AND POST_ID = #{postId} AND PARENT_COMMENT_ID IS NULL AND COMMENT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
